subject: Civil Engineering
title: Spillways: The Safety Valve
description: A short lesson to help you apply Spillways: The Safety Valve.

hook.text: A dam without a spillway is a ticking time bomb — water must have a safe way over or around.

buildup.text: Overflow spillways let water flow over a concrete crest — the simplest and most reliable type.

discovery.text: Energy dissipation at the base — stilling basins or ski-jump launches — prevents scour.

twist.text: The spillway must handle the probable maximum flood — the largest flood that could ever occur.

climax.text: Oroville Dam's spillway failed in 2017 — erosion ate through the concrete and threatened the dam.

punchline.text: The spillway is more important than the dam. Without it, the dam has no escape valve.

quiz.question: Why did the Oroville Dam spillway failure in 2017 threaten the entire dam?
options: The spillway collapse blocked the river downstream
Erosion ate through the concrete spillway, threatening uncontrolled flow that could breach the dam
The spillway generated too much hydroelectric power during the flood
